notes.title: Oblivious Garden - Rechecked and Rewritten
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It might be a little late, but we are here to tell you that after over three years since its release on Steam, we have finally finished rechecking and rewriting most of Oblivious Garden's chapters in order to provide you with a better understanding of the story.

We hope you'll be able to enjoy Oblivious Garden's wonderful story, and that elements that were missing or vague will now be clearer to you. If you're able to enjoy the story even a little more than before, then we'll know our efforts are paying off. So, at this memorable moment, would you like to buy Oblivious Garden for 50% off, or start playing it again?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/323490/Oblivious_Garden_Carmina_Burana/

Thank you very much for supporting Oblivious Garden~Carmina Burana. May the Goddess of the Moon bless you.

notes.title: May the Goddess of the Moon Bless You!
notes.content:
[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/419189600170508149/19B151F18A68BD80A6F7D8C723911B07ADF4E0F5/[/img]

Today, we are able to see the rare total lunar eclipse and supermoon for the first time since 1982. It is also the Mid-Autumn Festival/Chinese Moon Festival today, which takes place at the 15th day of the eighth Chinese lunar month. The reason for celebrating the festival during that time is that it is the time when the moon is at its fullest and brightest.

In the lands of Latoy, the peoples of Celantu are celebrating the Full Moon Festival, and it is said that Dyanna the Luna will be giving away free gifts for lucky guys.

Do you want it? Simply click on the link below:

http://t.cn/Ry9z4TH

Wish you have a good day.

=================================================================

中秋快乐！相信大家已经目睹了三十年一遇的超级月亮与月全食的双重奇观。在这个中国传统的团圆时刻，你的月饼是什么馅的呢？

同样，在《遗忘花园》的故事所发生的拉托伊大陆，人们也在这一天庆祝满月节的到来。传说月之女神狄安娜会在这天向幸运的人们送去礼物。

抽奖链接见下方，链接同样也会在SteamCN论坛公布。

http://t.cn/Ry9z4TH

祝中秋快乐，阖家幸福！

notes.title: Free White Day DLC and Weeklong Deals up to 75% OFF!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Do you want to hear one more story about our General and Princesses? We are very glad to announce that our new DLC - Oblivious Garden ~White Day is now available for FREE. And it should be automatically added to all the owners's account.

Oblivious Garden ~White Day is an additional chapter which tells the story between Irell and the noble princess, Leira. While setting in the same timeframe as the main story of Oblivious Garden, the events in White Day are independent from the main storyline. This chapter includes five new achievements which can be easily achieved. You may find this additional chapter at [Memory] -> [White Day].

To celebrate the release of this new DLC, Oblivious Garden ~Carmina Burana is now in Steam weeklong deals for 50% OFF, also with our great soundtrack for 75% OFF.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/323490/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/331520/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/345040/

《遗忘花园》的免费DLC《白色情人节》已于太平洋时间20日正式发布。同时，拥有《遗忘花园》本体的玩家将会自动获得该DLC。

这是一个全新的独立章节，讲述了前瑟兰图帝国将军艾尔与高贵公主莱拉之间不为人知的往事，另外还包含五个全新的成就。您可以在 [Memory] -> [White Day] 中进入此章节。

于此同时，《遗忘花园》本体和原声DLC正在进行周期特惠活动，本体的折扣为五折，原声的折扣为二五折，特惠持续一周，感兴趣的玩家请不要错过。

notes.content:

Some of you may have noticed that the game is updating frequently. This is because over the past few months we’ve been fixing the translation errors and bugs. notes.title: Two New Titles on Steam Greenlight
notes.content:
The page is here:

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=382635145

Created by the developers of Oblivious Garden ~Carmina Burana, 1/9 Black White Girl is a Reversi simulation visual novel. Zhang Jiali, who is a freshman in college, wants to make more friends to change herself by participating in college associations since she has few friends. She is only good at Reversi, but there was no association of Reversi in college. Therefore, Zhang Jiali decided to be head of the association and apply for the establishment of a Reversi association with her friend’s help... It took a long time after the college approved it, but finally only some weird girls enrolled in the association...

And, about The Innocent Luna: Eclipsed SinnerS:

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=382635716

In a far off corner of the world, there stands a peaceful but isolated town. 
Peaceful that is...until the murders began. Now the townspeople are living in a nightmare, fearful for their lives and the lives of their loved ones, distrustful of their neighbors for they know the murderer hides amongst them... You know their fear, you understand it, you've lived it. 
Your beloved has already been found dead, slain by the villain who preys upon your home. All that's left of her are memories...and dreams. 
In The Innocent Luna: Eclipsed SinnerS you'll follow your beloved into a world of dreams and nightmares searching for the truth behind her murder, and your own redemption...

Thank you very much for your support!

ːfinnheadː
ːfinnbodyː

notes.title: Progress
notes.content:
Hey folks, 

It's been a long time since we got greenlit. I have two news to tell you. 

The good news is, we've finished most work on Oblivious Garden ~Carmina Burana. The only thing we need to do now is import English text and press "release" button. 

The bad news is, myself, together with our English translators, are still dealing with the text which has over 300,000 words. Our current progress is 50%. Hope we can finish it before the end of this month. 

While I am still doing the translation, the rest of our people are working on a new title: 

http://steamcommunity.com//sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=340985523

Guess what it is? 

Thanks everyone, hope to see you soon. 

Cheers

EviloldE from D.E.Z. Studio 
_______________________________________________________________

各位亲们大家好， 

通过绿光也有挺长一段时间了，我有一个好消息和一个坏消息要告诉你们。 

好消息是，我们已经完成了《遗忘花园》的大部分发行前工作，目前要做的就是导入英文文本，然后点击发布按钮。 

坏消息是，我和几位翻译依然在努力对付那多达三十万字的文本，目前的进度大概是50%，希望能在月底前完成吧，只是希望。 

我们都是铁人三项选手，所以我们从来不休息，在遗忘花园仍然在翻译的时候，我们的下一部作品也开始了初期准备工作，依旧是国产同人。唯一的一张截图如下： 

http://steamcommunity.com//sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=340985523

猜猜是什么？ 

谢谢大家，下次见。 

老E（来自D.E.Z. Studio）
